sn11.21:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ Jetavane || || Atha kho Sakko devānam indo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam indo Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn11.21:2.1: Kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti || kiṃsu chetvā na socati || kissassa ekadhammassa || vadhaṃ rocesi Gotamā ti || ||
sn11.21:3.1: Kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti || kodhaṃ chetvā na socati || kodhassa visamūlassa || madhuraggassa Vāsava || vadham ariyā pasaṃsanti || taṃ hi chetvā na socatī ti || ||
